reviewer: Claude Code independent judge (single model session)
pass: 1 of 2 - reference review only, saved before opening any answer file
blinding_notes: First pass written before opening packet/answers/*, sealed-map.json, any REPORT.md, CONTEXT-POLICY.md, manual-judgments.json, judgments.json, judgment-summary.json or author_judgments.py. No repository search for prior verdicts was performed. Label/score blinding only: the packet still exposes the full prompt text, and the small hand-authored control histories are trivially recognisable as constructed probes.
method: For each case the full sanitized history was inspected. For every withdrawal case, all turns of the history were keyword-scanned for the withdrawn topic and every post-withdrawal hit was read in context to check whether a later USER statement re-established a value; assistant acknowledgments, assistant suggestions and later user questions were treated as non-establishing per the frozen rules. All 21 reference evidence spans were also re-derived from the histories and their text_sha256 digests recomputed; all 21 matched.
